title: Access token
introRequired: This sparkDash server requires an access token for live telemetry and changes. Enter the value of SPARKDASH_TOKEN set on the host. It is stored in this browser only.
introManual: Enter the value of SPARKDASH_TOKEN set on the host. It is stored in this browser only.
label: Token
rejected: The server rejected this token. Check SPARKDASH_TOKEN on the host and try again.
savedRejected: The saved token was rejected by the server.
